name: BACH_0144
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], 98% reliability [F6], and full model/neighbor agreement [F5] support tier-4 triage.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, others 0% (risk 0%) | Decisive score for Normal |
| Conformal set | Normal (alpha 0.1, 90% coverage) | Single class at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 68% OOD (12/12 regions) | Typical input, not flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (91%–92%); contrast InSitu BACH_0117 (84%) | Nearest neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.37, contrib -0.84) [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.12, contrib -0.46), unreliable 0/20 check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 7) · context · Above-typical descriptive score (1.01, contrib -0.39) [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.36, contrib +0.33) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in validation (top-region deletion drops invasive score +0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 check).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in situ lesion matches contrast case BACH_0117 (84% similar) or 8 neoplastic nuclei in region 10.
- Small validation set (132 cases, 24 patients) gives wide CIs for coverage (76%–98%) and ECE (4%–22%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 10**: Inspect 8 neoplastic and 14 epithelial nuclei segmented by HoVer-Net (insufficient tumor nuclei flagged).
2. **Regions 5, 6**: Verify two-layered lobules directly; normal-lobules concept is unreliable (0/20 AI spot check).
3. **Regions 1, 11**: Rule out duct-confined atypia or stromal invasion separating this slide from InSitu BACH_0117.
